title: Four ways to write butan-1-ol
caption: The same molecule, C₄H₁₀O, as a displayed formula (every bond and atom), a structural formula, CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH, and a skeletal formula, where each corner or line end is a carbon carrying enough hydrogens to make four bonds.
alt: Butan-1-ol drawn as a displayed formula with all hydrogens and as a skeletal formula, with the molecular and structural formulae as labels.
description: Left: the displayed formula, four carbons in a chain with every C–H bond drawn and O–H on the end carbon.
Right: the skeletal formula, a zigzag of three lines ending in OH.

claims.name: both drawings are the same compound
